recommendation.description: A non-enforcing recommendation for the human review workflow.

evidence_sufficiency_score.description: Completeness of the supplied evidence, not probability of legality or safety.

suggested_reviewer_action.description: A proposed next review step; this value grants no authority to execute it.

graph_entities_implicated.description: List of node IDs from the GraphRAG ontology implicated in the risk.

human_review_required.description: Always true for this regional skill.
